rationale: S-0002-04 proposes a factorial morphology sweep (branch orders, segment length, segment diameter) at fixed synapse count — the canonical RQ2 experiment. Pre-shunting-discovery framing. t0065 / t0066 showed that direction selectivity in both deposited model beds is dominated by the e_GABA = v_rest shunting design, not by morphology variation per se; morphology effects are downstream of that architectural choice. The factorial morphology sweep remains useful once a working from-scratch substrate exists (per S-0065-02) but is no longer top-of-queue. Reprioritising from high to medium so the high-priority shelf reflects the post-shunting-discovery critical path.
